summary: A server-rendered React app with page loaders, form actions and shared backend services with typed errors and structured logs.
description: Build server-rendered React pages with loaders, form actions and JSON resource routes in one application. Server programs share an Effect runtime, typed error handling and request logs, with a boundary that keeps server code out of components. A health route and browser smoke test establish the base. Data storage and accounts are not included; the optional openrouter-chat app adds the reference browser chat experience.
seoDescription: A server-rendered React Router app with Effect services, typed errors, request logs and tests through a health-route proving slice.

projectExamples.title: Request review console
projectExamples.description: Build server-loaded request pages and form actions around your own service. Add persistence, identity and access rules to suit the records being reviewed.

projectExamples.title: Browser model comparison notebook
projectExamples.description: Select openrouter-chat for streaming chat, model choice and Markdown export. Live requests need a key; private access and durable history require further work.
